name: OIDC provider unreachable: the expired token is renewed before the request with 3 attempts shared by the screen, then the popup
description: The token endpoint of the OIDC provider is unreachable. The background renewal fails, the token expires, the next screen change makes the application renew the token before the request: 3 attempts 1 second apart, one renewal for all widgets of the screen, then the popup "Session has expired". With the provider back, "Yes" leads to the login page.
descriptionHtml:
The token endpoint of the OIDC provider is unreachable. The background renewal fails, the token expires, the next screen change makes the application renew the token before the request: 3 attempts 1 second apart, one renewal for all widgets of the screen, then the popup "Session has expired". Manual run: 📋 Copy application.Samples.Feature.signInAgain.SignInAgainPopupTest#providerUnreachable_threeSharedAttemptsThenPopup into GitHub Actions → Run Workflow → include PATH
statusMessage: Environment variable [KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USER] does not exist ==> changes the state of the OIDC provider (test users, client token lifetime): run against a disposable Keycloak only
